samples.question: The cyan frame contains a 13-by-13 source mosaic. Read its 25 northwest-to-southeast diagonals in order, starting with the single bottom-left cell and ending with the single top-right cell. For each diagonal, write dark if it contains an odd number of dark source tiles and light if it contains an even number. Pack the 25 results left-to-right across five rows of a 5-by-5 result, without rotating or reflecting it; ignore gray grid lines and gold guide marks. Which reference card matches? Cards A, B, C, and D are in reading order: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.
